doc.title: Joe Wilder Part 1 interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996

title: Thanks and goodbyes
summary: Rowe thanks Wilder on behalf of Hamilton College and they say goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: That’s great. Well, on behalf of Hamilton College I want to thank you for fitting us into your schedule. It’s been such a pleasure.
Well thank you, Monk. And give my regards to all your faculty and students there.
And thank you, so much, for the interview.
Thanks a lot. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -10-
